title: Onboarding wizard reappears after site and controller creation
description: The onboarding wizard unexpectedly displays after a user creates a new site, adds a controller, and navigates to the dashboard. This bypasses the intended user flow.
steps: Add a controller to the newly created site.
actual: The onboarding wizard appears after completing the site and controller creation flow and navigating to the dashboard.
expected: The dashboard should be displayed without the onboarding wizard upon completion of site and controller creation.
